current_activity: part of the brigade is fed piecemeal against the US 26th Infantry Division around Eschdorf
notes: Event date: 23 December 1944 (Cole, ch. 21). Event definition: Only part of the newly arrived brigade is brought against the 26th Division during the 23d, mostly in small packets of infantry; it was to attack southeast from Heiderscheid and Eschdorf (Cole, ch. 21). Event support: one source family (the US Army official history (CMH)). Cole, The Ardennes, ch. 21, p. 522: "only a part of the Fuehrer Grenadier Brigade was brought against the 26th Division during the 23d". Location: Eschdorf, Luxembourg (new place) with a precision of 5 km. Location support: Cole names Heiderscheid and Eschdorf; the point is approximate. Opponents: US 26th Infantry Division.

location_qualifier: two rifle battalions and a few tanks
current_activity: two rifle battalions and a few tanks strike Liefrange to bar a crossing of the Sûre
notes: Event date: 27 December 1944, about 0720 (Cole, ch. 24). Event definition: Major von Courbiere, acting commander, is sent with two rifle battalions and a few tanks to bar a crossing at Liefrange (Cole, ch. 24). Event support: one source family (the US Army official history (CMH)). Cole, The Ardennes, ch. 24, p. 638: "was dispatched with two rifle battalions and a few tanks to bar a crossing at Liefrange". Location: Liefrange, Luxembourg (new place) with a precision of 3 km. Location support: Cole names Liefrange. Commander: Major von Courbiere, acting commander (Cole, ch. 24). Opponents: US 26th Infantry Division.

current_activity: withdrawn into the Seventh Army reserve at Wiltz
notes: Event date: last nights of December 1944 (Cole, ch. 24); 31 December is used (inferred value). Event definition: The brigade withdraws during the last nights of December into the Seventh Army reserve at Wiltz, replaced by the 9th Volks Grenadier Division (Cole, ch. 24). Event support: one source family (the US Army official history (CMH)). Cole, The Ardennes, ch. 24, p. 641: "had withdrawn during the last nights of December to go into the Seventh Army reserve at Wiltz". Location: Wiltz, Luxembourg with a precision of 5 km. Location support: Cole names Wiltz.
